attempts.text:
**The window starts in a long persistent spine.** Columns 0 to 35, `gmhB` to `dapD`, are carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, 35 persistent and 1 shell, and sit in a region of plasticity in 0 to 3% of calls. The model names 94 to 99.8% of genes there, fewest at `dapD`, 94%, and hesitates most at `ldcC`, 0.49 bits.

**A variable column follows**, column 36, `yaeI`, in a region of plasticity in 1% of calls, named 84%, 0.62 bits. Then columns 37 to 51, `yaeH` to `fhuC`, all persistent, carried by 94 to 96%, in a region of plasticity in 2 to 4% of calls; the model names 87 to 98%, fewest at `fhuC`, 87%. Column 52, `fhuA`, is variable, in a region of plasticity in 4% of calls, named 90%.

**Columns 53 to 60 stay persistent**, `mrcB` to `folK`, carried by 95 to 96%, though in a region of plasticity in 3 to 46% of calls. The model names 74 to 97% there, fewest and most hesitant at `folK`, 74%, 0.47 bits. Then the window opens widest: columns 61 to 67 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 37 to 85% of calls, named 26 to 77%, fewest at column 64, 26%, most hesitant at `htrE`, 1.05 bits. The forks carry `yadN`, `yadV`, `htrE` and `yadK`, [[fimbrial and pilus proteins]].

**The last spine runs from `panB` to `gcd`**, columns 68 to 78, all persistent, carried by 91 to 96%, in a region of plasticity in 3 to 8% of calls, named 86 to 97%, fewest at `panB`, 86%. Column 79, `cueO`, is a fork, carried by 85%, in a region of plasticity in 5% of calls, named 95%.

**The model names 92% of genes overall**, 0.20 bits on average. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.97 against 0.12 bits, and names fewer genes, 39% against 98%.

label: gmhB
facts:
WINDOW: the gmhB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor gmhB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,513 to 3,592 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying gmhB once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.20 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,267 calls, named 99%, 0.10 bits; shell 5,455 calls, named 51%, 0.81 bits; cloud 238 calls, named 0%, 2.27 bits. Outside an RGP 38,895 calls, named 98%, 0.12 bits; inside an RGP 4,065 calls, named 39%, 0.97 bits. Columns: 70 spine, 4 fork, 6 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.97 against 0.12 bits) and names fewer genes (39% against 98%); 4,065 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 63 (htrE) 1.05 bits, RGP 85%; column 61 (yadN) 0.88 bits, RGP 84%; column 62 (yadV) 0.88 bits, RGP 85%. The 6 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 48%, 0.70 bits on average; the other 74 columns: named 96%, 0.16 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 61-67 (fork and variable columns), RGP 37-85%; the least: column 36 (variable), RGP 1%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-35 (36 columns) spine: share 91-100%, 35 P, 1 S, RGP 0-3%. Genes: gmhB, metN, metI "methionine ABC transporter permease…", metQ, rcsF, tsaA, proS, yaeF "YaeF family permuted papain-like en…", nlpE, arfB, yaeQ "YaeQ family protein", yaeP "YaeP family protein", rof, tilS, yaeR "VOC family protein", ldcC, accA, dnaE, rnhB, lpxB "lipid-A-disaccharide synthase", lpxA, fabZ, lpxD, skp, bamA, rseP, cdsA, ispU "(2E,6E)-farnesyl-diphosphate-specif…", ispC, frr, pyrH, tsf, rpsB, map, glnD, dapD. named 94-99.8% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 35 (dapD), named 94%; most hesitant at column 15 (ldcC), 0.49 bits.
2. column 36 variable: RGP 1%. named 84%; 0.62 bits.
   36: yaeI S 55% "phosphodiesterase YaeI"
3. columns 37-51 (15 columns) spine: share 94-96%, all P, RGP 2-4%. Genes: yaeH "DUF3461 family protein", cdaR, degP, dgt, mtnN, btuF, yadS "TRIC cation channel family protein", erpA, yadW "small protein YadW", clcA, yadX, hemL, fhuB "iron chelate uptake ABC transporter…", fhuD, fhuC. named 87-98% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 51 (fhuC), named 87%; most hesitant at column 47 (yadX), 0.33 bits.
4. column 52 variable: RGP 4%. named 90%; 0.42 bits.
   52: fhuA S 78%
5. columns 53-60 (8 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 3-46%. Genes: mrcB, hrpB, thpR, sfsA, dksA, gluQRS, pcnB, folK. named 74-97% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 60 (folK), named 74%, 0.47 bits.
6. columns 61-67 (7 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 37-85%. named 26-77% (mean 52%), fewest named at column 64, named 26%; most hesitant at column 63, 1.05 bits.
   61 fork: yadN S 57% "fimbrial protein"; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 23%, yadV S 14%
   62 fork: yadV S 57%; also htrE S 13%
   63 variable: htrE S 49%
   64 variable: yadM S 35% "fimbrial protein"
   65 variable: yadL S 35% "fimbrial-like protein YadL"
   66 fork: yadK S 48% "fimbrial-like protein"; also "fimbrial protein" S 11%
   67 variable: yadC S 27% "fimbrial-like adhesin"
7. columns 68-78 (11 columns) spine: share 91-96%, all P, RGP 3-8%. Genes: panB, panC "pantoate--beta-alanine ligase", rpnC, panD, yadE, yadI "PTS sugar transporter subunit IIA", yadH "ABC transporter permease", yadG "ATP-binding cassette domain-contain…", can, hpt, gcd. named 86-97% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 68 (panB), named 86%; most hesitant at column 69 (panC), 0.43 bits.
8. column 79 fork: RGP 5%. named 95%; 0.19 bits.
   79: cueO P 85%; also yacC P 55%, speE P 27%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): metN methionine ABC transporter ATP-binding…; metQ methionine ABC transporter substrate-bi…; lpxA acyl-ACP--UDP-N-acetylglucosamine O-acy…; ispC 1-deoxy-D-xylulose-5-phosphate reductoi…; fhuD ABC transporter substrate-binding prote…; fhuC ATP-binding cassette domain-containing…; fhuA ferrichrome porin FhuA; panB 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate hydroxymethyltr…; yadN fimbrial protein; yadV fimbria/pilus periplasmic chaperone; htrE FimD/PapC N-terminal domain-containing…; yacC YacC family pilotin-like protein; speE polyamine aminopropyltransferase
END: the window ends at column 79, cueO, in 85% of chromosomes.
